banner.title: Your Privacy & Cookie Preferences
banner.text: Donorfit uses essential cookies to ensure secure platform functionality. With your consent, we also use functional and privacy-focused analytics cookies to evaluate website traffic and optimize our fundraising resources. You can customize your preferences anytime.

dialog.title: Cookie Preferences Manager
dialog.introBefore: We prioritize user privacy and comply strictly with the European Union GDPR and ePrivacy Directive. Choose which cookie categories you permit Donorfit to employ. Read our full

necessary.name: Strictly Necessary Cookies
necessary.description: Required for core platform security, session tokens, load balancing, and CSRF protection. Cannot be disabled.

preferences.name: Functional & Preference Cookies
preferences.description: Remembers your chosen language, country selection, and form completion state.

analytics.name: Performance & Analytics Cookies
analytics.description: Aggregated, privacy-respecting metrics to measure page performance and donation flow drop-off without storing IP addresses.

marketing.name: Marketing & Outreach Cookies
marketing.description: Allows us to assess our non-profit digital outreach campaigns and measure inbound demo inquiry channels.
